name: Inner/Outer/Inner Walls, Bone Infill and Arc Fitting
author: quix2k23
description: Adds 'Inner/Outer/Inner' to Wall Ordering, a bone-like 'Bone' infill pattern and arc fitting (G2/G3), and collapses the setting categories when the All preset is chosen so the settings panel appears at once. Needs the patched CuraEngine (see backend/location).
